input.command: python -c 'import duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json, os; p="data/crashes.parquet"; out="out"; os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True); con=duckdb.connect(); df=con.execute("SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INT AS year, CAST(SUM(number_of_motorist_killed) AS BIGINT) AS motorist_deaths, CAST(SUM(number_of_cyclist_killed) AS BIGINT) AS cyclist_deaths FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2025 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year", [p]).df(); df.to_csv(out+"/values_1.csv", index=False); df.to_csv(out+"/values_2.csv", index=False); years=df.year.astype(int); motor=df.motorist_deaths.astype(int); cycle=df.cyclist_deaths.astype(int); plt.figure(figsize=(11.5,6.4)); plt.plot(years,motor,color="#1f5a94",marker="o",linewidth=2.6,markersize=5.5,label="Motorist deaths"); plt.plot(years,cycle,color="#d17b27",marker="o",linewidth=2.6,markersize=5.5,label="Cyclist deaths"); plt.xticks(years, rotation=0); plt.xlim(2012.7,2025.3); plt.ylim(0,160); plt.ylabel("Deaths (count)"); plt.xlabel("Year of crash"); plt.title("Motorist and cyclist deaths in NYC by year, 2013–2025"); plt.suptitle("Annual sums of crash-level deaths reported in the crash file",y=.94,fontsize=10,color="#555555"); plt.grid(axis="y",alpha=.25); plt.legend(frameon=False,ncol=2,loc="upper left"); plt.tight_layout(rect=[0,0,1,.92]); plt.savefig(out+"/option_1.png",dpi=180,bbox_inches="tight"); plt.close(); x=range(len(df)); width=.38; plt.figure(figsize=(11.5,6.4)); plt.bar([i-width/2 for i in x],motor,width,color="#1f5a94",label="Motorist deaths"); plt.bar([i+width/2 for i in x],cycle,width,color="#d17b27",label="Cyclist deaths"); plt.xticks(list(x),years); plt.ylim(0,160); plt.ylabel("Deaths (count)"); plt.xlabel("Year of crash"); plt.title("Motorist and cyclist deaths in NYC by year, 2013–2025"); plt.suptitle("Annual sums of crash-level deaths reported in the crash file",y=.94,fontsize=10,color="#555555"); plt.grid(axis="y",alpha=.25); plt.legend(frameon=False,ncol=2,loc="upper left"); plt.tight_layout(rect=[0,0,1,.92]); plt.savefig(out+"/option_2.png",dpi=180,bbox_inches="tight"); plt.close(); print(df.to_string(index=False)); print("Saved two charts and values CSVs")'
